name: Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter
description: Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter was a Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor piloted by Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano during the Clone Wars, periodically flying with R7-A7 as her astromech droid co-pilot. She piloted the ship during the Battle of Ryloth and the Battle of Umbara.
